title: The degree of a locally free module of constant rank is unchanged by extension of the base field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the degree of a locally free module E/X/k of constant rank equals the degree of its base change E_{k'}/X_{k'}/k'. The proof sets X_{k'} equal to the base change of X and E_{k'} equal to the pullback along the projection, then applies flat base change for cohomology to identify H^i(X_{k'}, E_{k'}) with H^i(X, E) tensor_k k' and similarly for the structure sheaf (proof lines 9579-9586). Since the Euler characteristics are therefore unchanged, so is the degree (proof lines 9587-9588). H2: the reduction of the claim to two flat-base-change identifications is short but complete, and the constant-rank hypothesis is exactly what the degree formula needs.
